Elena (Partnerships): Quick sync — AccelSys wants to start outreach on the March SI intake list. Need to lock the intake/claiming rules so Sales + SI don't overlap. TL;DR: 48h claim window, match by ACV band, revops queue.

Priya (Accelsys SI Ops): 👍 we can take 8 active pursuits this sprint. 48h window works if we get account tags + MQL ids.

Omar (Sales AE): How will claims show up in SF? SDRs currently route to AE queue; we need a separate 'SI-Intake' queue. @Sam can RevOps create that?

Sam (RevOps): Yep. I'll spin up an 'si_intake_claims' queue with a tag 'si_candidate=true'. Will add workflow to auto-assign to AccelSys when claimed. ETA end of day.

Elena (Partnerships): Cool. Proposal for claim protocol:
- Partner submits lead via partner portal (or CSV to Partnerships slack channel)
- RevOps creates placeholder opportunity in SF with 'si_candidate' tag
- 48 hour hold for partner to claim by updating 'claimed_by' field
- If unclaimed after 48h, AE auto-owns
- Conflicts escalate to Partnerships (that channel) and AE's manager

Priya (Accelsys SI Ops): One ask — can we get ACV banding and product interest in the intake payload? We prioritize HC/enterprise deals.

Elena (Partnerships): yes. minimal payload:
```
account_name,account_id,est_acv,product_interest,mql_id,region
```
Send to partners@redwood.com or upload to partner portal.

Omar (Sales AE): Also we need a short blackout rule: if AE has engaged >2 contacts in last 30 days, block partner claim unless AE approves.

Tina (Legal): Quick flag: any co-sell with joint logos or joint announcement needs a signed co-marketing addendum. If you plan PR, loop Legal before scheduling.

Priya (Accelsys SI Ops): Noted. We'll only tag for outreach once co-marketing is cleared.

MarketplaceBot: scheduled: AccelSys integration announcement draft due 2026-04-02. link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/accelsys-announcement

Elena (Partnerships): Action items:
- @Sam create queue + claim fields (in progress)
- @Priya send example CSV + capacity count (said 8)
- @Omar confirm blackout rule wording
- @Tina confirm co-marketing checklist + turnaround
I'll compile a one-pager for partners tomorrow morning and post it here. 

Omar (Sales AE): Sounds good. I'll ping my SDR lead to hold outreach until we have the queue.

Priya (Accelsys SI Ops): We'll prepare our intake script and a short SOP for claim steps.

Sam (RevOps): Queue created, added 'si_candidate' flag and 'claimed_by' fields. Prod change scheduled 20:00 PST.

Elena (Partnerships): Perfect — thanks everyone :pray:
